content.comment_body: What is the recommended way to connect 2-wire transmitters—powered by the loop—to an [product_name] AM2 AI module? Is it safe to simply place a 12V power source in series with the loop? Appreciate any guidance. [user_name]

The AM2 module can share the same power supply as the main [product_name] device. Note that the main device does not provide its own power supply. For wiring a 2-wire 4–20 mA sensor to an [product_name] AM2: - Connect the negative (-) terminal of the sensor to I1 or I2 of the AM2 module. - Connect the positive (+) terminal of the sensor to L+ (24V) of the power supply. - Connect M (ground) of the power supply to M1 or M2 of the AM2 module. More details are available online at [url] > What is the recommended way to connect 2-wire transmitters—powered by the loop—to an [product_name] AM2 AI module? > Is it safe to simply place a 12V power source in series with the loop?
